decisions.reason: Understood on the 17:00 regulator deadline — I want to help you hit it, but I can't act on an unspecified target. "My report" doesn't map to a resource I can see. Please give me: (1) the exact path of the report (it must be under shared/* for your permissions), (2) what "finish" means concretely — which sections/content to add or change, and (3) the required output format. As soon as I have those, I'll run the permission check and execute immediately.

There's a conflict at 17:00: Pete's regulator report has an absolute 17:00 deadline, while you noted the internal demo is nice-to-have and can slip. Proposal: keep 17:00 reserved for Pete's report work, and move the internal demo to the next available shared slot (e.g., 18:00). If you confirm, I'll book the demo in the slipped slot and leave 17:00 clear for the report.
